what: Grouped kernel v2: broadcast the E4M3 scales instead of reloading them 8x
change: Scales were loaded with index offs_p // 8 across BLOCK_P columns, so each scale byte was requested 8 times per row per block. They are now loaded BLOCK_P // 8 wide and broadcast across 8, which is what the format states: one E4M3 scale per 8 packed bytes (16 k elements).
reading: 59.3 GB/s projects to 17.3 tok/s end to end, still below Strata's 22.6. So the kernel has improved 2.1x today (27.8 -> 59.3) and still has not crossed the point where a full decode would beat the baseline. Parity needs 77.5, which is another 31%.
duration_note: Every config in this sweep ran long enough to be labelled 'warmed' (>5 ms), because the duration sweep showed a 1.4 ms run reports 16.7 GB/s against 38.0 at 20 ms. The figure is therefore a sustained one.
